summary: Known issue in community.general: homectl and udm_user do not work on Python 3.13 or newer because they rely on the removed crypt standard library module.
questions: Why does homectl fail on Python 3.13?
udm_user crashes with a crypt import error, what's wrong?
Which community.general modules break on Python 3.13?

answer_card.title: homectl and udm_user fail on Python 3.13
answer_card.answer_md: `community.general.homectl` and `udm_user` rely on the **`crypt`** module, which was removed from the Python 3.13 standard library. They do not work on **Python 3.13+**; run them with an older Python on the target.
